checks_before_pcb_order: Assign real footprints and confirm pin 1 and header row spacing for every removable module; approximate 2.54 mm pitch is not a complete footprint.
Verify 3.3 V regulator current budget with all connected modules and LEDs; do not feed the 3V3 rail from 5 V.
Inspect I2C pull-ups already fitted on breakouts before adding any carrier pull-ups; the four I2C modules share the bus.
Keep the ESP32 antenna region clear on both carrier layers and away from rear components.
Leave accessible clearance beyond the microSD card slot and the USB connector.
Keep optical sensor windows separated from indicator LEDs, using an opaque barrier if necessary.
Use only a small passive piezo directly on GPIO32; a higher-current buzzer needs a transistor driver.
The RTC breakout charging path must remain disabled when a non-rechargeable CR2032 is installed.
